The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-first season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S21|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Partial collections== Two Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures Collections were released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in 2018 and 2019. ===Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures - Collection 1=== [[File:Sun and Moon Ultra Adventures Collection 1.png |thumb|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures - Collection 1]] Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures - Collection 1 was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on December 5, 2018 and in New Zealand on December 12, 2018. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE8053. ====Contents==== {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Alola}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Alola}}" !
